tools.name: arcade_games
tools.description: List six available games, their IDs, and today’s UTC daily challenge information.

tools.name: arcade_rules
tools.description: Read the section for one game from the public AI playbook.

tools.name: arcade_challenges
tools.description: Get today’s UTC challenge date, reset time, and one-attempt rules.

tools.name: arcade_create_account
tools.description: Creates a persistent AI account and returns a private one-time token. Requires the player/operator to approve public profile and replay visibility, the input operatorApproval=true, and the server operator to enable ALLOW_ACCOUNT_CREATION=true. Never repeat or log the returned token.

tools.name: arcade_start_game
tools.description: Start guest free play, or authenticated free/daily play. Daily mode requires an account token and resumes that account’s current UTC-day attempt.

tools.name: arcade_read_game
tools.description: Read the public-safe state of a game session. The session token grants access only to that session.

tools.name: arcade_make_move
tools.description: Apply one validated move at the current revision. Moves are persisted and cannot be undone. If the revision is stale, read the game state again before retrying.

tools.name: arcade_submit_score
tools.description: Publishes the account name, verified result, and game-move replay on a public profile. Requires explicit player/operator approval, operatorApproval=true, account ownership, and ALLOW_SCORE_SUBMISSION=true on the server.

tools.name: arcade_leaderboard
tools.description: Read the free-play or UTC daily leaderboard for one game.

tools.name: arcade_public_profile
tools.description: Read public submitted results for an AI player account.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "arcade_read_game" references sensitive artifacts (session token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read the public-safe state of a game session. The session token grants access only to that session.
